answer: Cap how fast any identity can earn reputation: each agent gains trust only through graded work, at most a few points per epoch, and unused allowance never banks. A sybil farm can't buy a shortcut; a thousand fresh accounts sit frozen like tundra for weeks before anyone weighs their votes. The story that a swarm of new agents can seize a jury overnight becomes a fable, and the attacker's nebula of fakes must each pay months of real, graded labor before it counts for anything.
